items.title: Frame.io adds full-screen search and Comparison Viewer updates
items.excerpt: Adobe's Frame.io rolls out a dedicated full-screen search page with a toggle between standard and AI-powered search, plus Comparison Viewer updates, letting editors and post teams find and review footage across projects faster. A concrete workflow shift for how film/TV review-and-approval teams navigate media.

items.title: Introducing Layers
items.excerpt: Luma AI launched Layers, giving creators precision editing and element-by-element control over any AI-generated image inside its filmmaking toolset, rather than re-rolling a whole prompt. A craft-level capability that pushes generative work toward the directed, revisable control filmmakers and previs artists expect.
